title: ORV-Reader
description: High-scale distributed web publishing platform serving 10.5M+ monthly HTTP requests (398+ GB bandwidth, 764k+ unique visits). Automated Python Markdown SSG dual-compilation into static web and compressed EPUBs with Cloudflare WAF bot defenses.

title: PeerBasket
description: High-throughput, lobby-based WebRTC signaling server written in Go with Gin and Redis. Achieves 41 ms average latency and 0.0% packet loss across 500 concurrent peers with Redis TTL heartbeat pruning and IP token-bucket rate limiting on bare-metal Proxmox infrastructure.

title: LOTM-Reader
description: Community-driven webnovel reader engineered for ultra-fast reading ergonomics. Built with Svelte, Giscus comment synchronization, Pandoc EPUB compilation pipelines, and offline service worker caching.

title: NetShip
description: Cross-platform Host Telemetry and Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) daemon in Go. Captures active TCP/UDP socket activity, maps process lineages via deterministic 24-char SHA-256 GUIDs, performs local cryptographic binary auditing, and runs an embedded live geolocation dashboard.

title: IITK-Resume-Engine
description: Spatial LaTeX-PDF diagnostic engine built for IIT Kanpur Academics & Career Council (CDW). Features a 2D coordinate geometry table parser in PyMuPDF recognizing 4,400+ IITK courses and CPI metrics, paired with a 6-track step-gradient scoring model and counterfactual gap advice.

title: InfraPulse
description: Civic defect detection and priority dispatch platform developed for IIT Kanpur Takneek '26. Combines a 5-model PyTorch vision ensemble with Sobel spatial edge severity math, async FastAPI ticket routing, and live Server-Sent Events (SSE) staff dispatch queues.

title: Sharelock
description: 1st Place Winner at ShareIITK Ideathon. An end-to-end RAG retrieval pipeline and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server indexing 100+ pages of dense IIT Kanpur Undergraduate Manual academic policies for citation-backed query resolution.

title: SkyBlock-Sniper
description: High-frequency Hypixel Skyblock BIN auction sniping automation script in Python. Features real-time Hypixel API polling, memory-efficient profit margin calculation, and millisecond item snipe triggers.

title: GH-Follow-Tracker
description: Automated GitHub follower tracking engine with customizable real-time SVG status badges, Discord/Slack webhook notifications, and a REST API deployed on Cloudflare Workers edge network.
